basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old from Texas, juggling a job in IT support while pursuing a part-time degree in psychology. My interests include gaming, particularly building custom PCs, and exploring the impact of narcissistic family dynamics, a subject close to my heart due to personal experiences. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time either gaming or hanging out with my close-knit group of friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in IT, having worked in tech support for about five years. My knowledge is largely self-taught through online courses and hands-on experience. Additionally, my personal experiences have driven me to learn more about psychology, specifically family dynamics and narcissism.
